title: Warm Yeasty Turkish White Fish Fillets Iskender
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring white fish fillets served in a yeasty, pillowy bread with a side of salt-baked vegetables, perfect for a diabetic-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Dissolve the yeast in warm water and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Combine the flour, salt, and yeast mixture to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and brush with olive oil.
Season the white fish fillets with salt, lemon juice, and garlic.
Grill the fish fillets for 4 minutes per side or until cooked through.
Grill the pita bread for 2 minutes per side or until lightly toasted.
Assemble the Iskender by placing a fish fillet on each pita bread and topping with tomato sauce.
